progression.narrative: The performance opens on F#4 and dwells most on B in Daramad IV. The line peaks at C#5 (569.2 Hz) at 0:42.6. It closes on Gs4, not the tonic (B4 → C#5 → B4 → B4 → A4 → Gs4).
